title: Relay
text: Switch output between two constants, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Switch on point} sets the input value which switches the relay, {Switch off point} sets the input value which switches the relay, {Output when on} sets the output value when the relay, {Output when off} sets the output value when the relay, {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the data type of output signal and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Switch on point
params.values: Input value which switches the relay on ’eps’ (default) | scalar

params.name: Switch off point
params.values: Input value which switches the relay off ’eps’ (default) | scalar

params.name: Output when on
params.values: Output value when the relay is on 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Output when off
params.values: Output value when the relay is off 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Specify sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output signal Inherit: All ports same datatype (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | int8 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | |...

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
